images.note: Panel from the multi-source 286-294 GHz gallery (8''-wide square field of view centred on the emission peak). The brightest disk in the sample: a bright compact peak with clearly extended 1.0 mm emission, including a second lobe/extension toward the south-west, so it is the most nearly resolved source in this set although still only marginally resolved at the ~1.0-1.2'' SMA beam scale. F(294 GHz) = 617.0 +/- 34.7 mJy, F(278 GHz) = 538.3 +/- 31.2 mJy (visibility-domain fits, Table 4); no peak brightness in mJy/beam is tabulated. Table 1: WSB 31 = Elias 2-24, R_95% = 0.98'' (~133 au at 136 pc), K6, single, group 2. The 286-298 GHz high LSB data come from the SMA 270 GHz tracks 270 GHz-2a (2022-05-23, EXT) and 270 GHz-1 (2023-08-29, COM); the paper does not state which track contributes to which target.
